old_dump.description: Path to the old PostgreSQL dump file (positional argument)

new_dump.description: Path to the new PostgreSQL dump file (positional argument)

add_defaults.description: Adds DEFAULT clause for NOT NULL columns without explicit default

add_transaction.description: Wraps diff output with START TRANSACTION and COMMIT

ignore_function_whitespace.description: Ignores whitespace differences in function definitions (risky)

ignore_schema_creation.description: Removes requirement for CREATE SCHEMA in input files

in_charset.description: Input charset for reading dump files (Java-compatible name)

out_charset.description: Output charset for writing diff file (Java-compatible name)

output_ignored_statements.description: Outputs info about ignored DDL statements

list_charsets.description: Lists all supported charsets (for verification/debug only)
